tools.name: tg_send
tools.description: Send a line, or one local image, to a Telegram chat through this bot. photo must be inside an allowed directory; a directory means the newest image inside it. chatId/chat picks the target, blank means the chat that last wrote.

text.description: Text to send, or the caption when photo is set.

photo.description: Absolute path of an image file or a directory (the newest image inside is used).

chatId.description: Optional chat id, "last", or part of a chat title.

chat.description: Optional chat title such as 小窝.

summary.zh: 通过 Telegram bot 发一句话，或一张本机图片（限允许的目录）。
summary.en: Send a line, or one local image from an allowed directory, on Telegram.

description.zh: 人在 Telegram 上发来的一条消息（只来自 allow 名单里的会话）。
description.en: One message the person sent on Telegram, from an allow-listed chat only.
